fields.label: API Key (Key ID)
fields.description: Razorpay Key ID from Dashboard → Settings → API Keys. Starts with 'rzp_live_' or 'rzp_test_'.

fields.label: API Secret (Key Secret)
fields.description: Razorpay Key Secret generated alongside the Key ID. Keep this confidential.

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Secret string set when registering the webhook in the Razorpay Dashboard. Used to verify incoming webhook signatures.

fields.label: System User
fields.description: ERPNext user under whose name Payment Entries will be created.
